interpretations: For each invoice, average its `InvoiceLine.UnitPrice` values, subtract the mean of those invoice averages, then subtract the mean deviation for invoices whose customers have the same `Customer.Country`. Return the 10 largest results.

For each invoice, average its `InvoiceLine.UnitPrice` values, subtract the mean price across all invoice lines, then subtract the mean deviation for invoices whose customers have the same `Customer.Country`. Return the 10 largest results.

For each invoice, average its `InvoiceLine.UnitPrice` values, take the absolute difference from the mean of all invoice averages, then subtract its country’s mean absolute deviation. Return the 10 largest results.

For each invoice, average its `InvoiceLine.UnitPrice` values, take the absolute difference from the mean price across all invoice lines, then subtract its country’s mean absolute deviation. Return the 10 largest results.
For each invoice, calculate the signed deviation from the mean of all invoice averages, then rank invoices by that deviation’s absolute distance from their country’s mean signed deviation.
For each invoice, calculate the signed deviation from the mean of all invoice averages, subtract its country’s mean signed deviation, and return only positive results, up to 10 invoices.

Treat each purchased unit equally when calculating an invoice’s average `UnitPrice`, weighting each line by `Quantity`; compare that average with the mean of the quantity-weighted invoice averages and with its country’s mean deviation.
Treat each purchased unit equally when calculating an invoice’s average `UnitPrice`; compare it with the quantity-weighted average price of all purchased units and with its country’s mean deviation.
Use `Invoice.BillingCountry` as the country associated with each invoice when calculating its country’s average deviation.
Give each customer equal weight when calculating a country’s average deviation, rather than giving each invoice equal weight.
Include invoices with no lines, showing blank calculated values and placing them last.
queries:
WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT i.InvoiceId,
           c.Country,
           AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS invoice_average
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country
),
deviations AS (
    SELECT Country,
           invoice_average - AVG(invoice_average) OVER () AS deviation
    FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS result
FROM deviations
ORDER BY result DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT i.InvoiceId,
           c.Country,
           AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_price
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    JOIN Customer AS c ON c.CustomerId = i.CustomerId
    GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, c.Country
),
deviations AS (
    SELECT InvoiceId,
           Country,
           avg_price - (SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) FROM InvoiceLine) AS deviation
    FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT InvoiceId,
       deviation - AVG(deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY Country) AS result
FROM deviations
ORDER BY result DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT i.InvoiceId,
           i.BillingCountry,
           AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS average_price
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, i.BillingCountry
),
means AS (
    SELECT InvoiceId,
           BillingCountry,
           average_price,
           AVG(average_price) OVER () AS overall_mean,
           AVG(average_price) OVER (
               PARTITION BY BillingCountry
           ) AS country_mean
    FROM invoice_averages
),
deviations AS (
    SELECT InvoiceId,
           BillingCountry,
           ABS(average_price - overall_mean) AS overall_deviation,
           ABS(average_price - country_mean) AS country_deviation
    FROM means
)
SELECT InvoiceId,
       overall_deviation
       - AVG(country_deviation) OVER (
           PARTITION BY BillingCountry
       ) AS result
FROM deviations
ORDER BY result DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH invoice_prices AS (
  SELECT i.InvoiceId, i.BillingCountry, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS avg_price
  FROM Invoice AS i
  JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
  GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, i.BillingCountry
),
global_price AS (
  SELECT AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_price
  FROM InvoiceLine
),
deviations AS (
  SELECT
    ip.InvoiceId,
    ip.BillingCountry,
    ABS(ip.avg_price - gp.avg_price) AS absolute_deviation
  FROM invoice_prices AS ip
  CROSS JOIN global_price AS gp
)
SELECT
  InvoiceId,
  absolute_deviation
    - AVG(absolute_deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY BillingCountry) AS result
FROM deviations
ORDER BY result DESC
LIMIT 10

WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT i.InvoiceId, i.BillingCountry, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS invoice_average
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, i.BillingCountry
),
deviations AS (
    SELECT
        InvoiceId,
        BillingCountry,
        invoice_average - AVG(invoice_average) OVER () AS signed_deviation
    FROM invoice_averages
)
SELECT
    InvoiceId,
    signed_deviation,
    RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY BillingCountry
        ORDER BY ABS(
            signed_deviation - AVG(signed_deviation) OVER (
                PARTITION BY BillingCountry
            )
        ) DESC
    ) AS deviation_rank
FROM deviations

WITH invoice_averages AS (
    SELECT i.InvoiceId, i.BillingCountry, AVG(il.UnitPrice) AS invoice_average
    FROM Invoice AS i
    JOIN InvoiceLine AS il ON il.InvoiceId = i.InvoiceId
    GROUP BY i.InvoiceId, i.BillingCountry
),
deviations AS (
    SELECT
        InvoiceId,
        BillingCountry,
        invoice_average - AVG(invoice_average) OVER () AS signed_deviation
    FROM invoice_averages
),
adjusted AS (
    SELECT
        InvoiceId,
        signed_deviation
            - AVG(signed_deviation) OVER (PARTITION BY BillingCountry) AS result
    FROM deviations
)
SELECT InvoiceId, result
FROM adjusted
WHERE result > 0
ORDER BY InvoiceId
LIMIT 10
